rows.evaluation_data_html:
Submit the following for FAA review:

  • 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their cardiologist or treating physician no more than 90 days before the AME exam.

It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up.

  • 2. Personal Statement (typed) describing your history of tobacco use in any form (e.g. cigarettes, cigars, pipes, vapes, or chewing tobacco) or tobacco cessation aids (e.g., vapes, gum, patches, lozenges, Chantix).
  • Include start and stop dates (MM/YYYY), daily amount used, and whether you currently use tobacco.
  • If currently using any form of tobacco, list the type, how much, and how often.
  • 3. Results of any other testing already performed by the treating physician.
